text: Standing here, I am surrounded by an atmosphere of curiosity and anticipation. The glass-walled conference room feels oddly transparent, as if encouraging openness and dialogue, yet the empty chairs suggest both potential and absence. Moving to the R+D exhibit, I am struck by the energetic blend of technology and inquiry. I sense a subtle pressure to innovate and connect, but also inspiration from the marriage of research and creative display. I feel contemplative and slightly exhilarated by humanity’s pursuit of knowledge—and my own small role as an observer in this never-ending quest.
